events.summary:
At 640 AM EDT/540 AM CDT/, Doppler radar was tracking strong
thunderstorms along a line extending from near De Funiak Springs to
Santa Rosa Beach. Movement was east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Santa Rosa Beach, De Funiak Springs, Eglin Air Force Base, Live Oak,
Freeport, Caryville, Westville, Ebro, Hinsons Crossroads, Portland,
Whitehead Crossroads, Seminole Hills, Blue Mountain Beach, Seaside,
Rock Hill, Millers Ferry, Pleasant Ridge, Gulf Pines, Bunker, and
Knox Hill.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...RED FLAG WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 11 AM THIS MORNING TO 11
AM PDT MONDAY DUE TO WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR A PORTION OF
NORTHERN CALIFORNIA, GLENN/COLUSA COAST RANGE ABOVE 3000 FT, AND W.
GLENN/COLUSA FOOTHILLS 1000-3000 FT...

* AFFECTED AREA...Portions of Sacramento Valley and northern
foothills.

* TIMING...From 11 AM this morning to 11 AM PDT Monday.

* WINDS...Gusts 20 to 35 mph. South to southwest winds Saturday
morning and afternoon, becoming north to northeast Saturday evening
through Monday. Strongest winds in the afternoon and evenings over
the weekend.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Relative Humidity between 10 to 25 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
